description: Compute one statistic over a single column: sum, avg, min or max (numeric, rounded to 2 dp, blanks ignored), count of non-empty cells, or the sorted distinct values. Use for quick answers like 'total of the price column'. Do NOT use to reshape the table; use split_column or convert_table.

column.description: Column to use: the exact header name (case-sensitive), or a 0-based column index as digits, e.g. "price" or "2".

data.description: The whole table as text, first row = header. CSV/TSV text (quoted cells allowed), or a JSON array of flat objects, e.g. "name,age\nAsha,30".

format.description: Format of 'data' and of the returned table: csv, tsv or json. Default csv.

op.description: Statistic: sum, avg, min, max (column must be numeric), count (non-empty cells) or distinct (unique values).

name: column_stats

column.description: Header name of the column that was analysed.

result.description: Numeric result for sum/avg/min/max/count, or a sorted array of distinct string values for distinct.

title: Column stats
